title.narrative: Digital Governance and Economy Project (Contingent Emergency Response Component)

description.narrative: UNOPS will provide procurement and distribution support to the National Sustainable Development Fund (FNDS), under the leadership and oversight of Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MADER), for the implementation of specific activities and components of the Digital Governance and Economy Project, Contingent Emergency Response Component, C4). UNOPS will assist FNDS in the procurement and distribution of emergency Agricultural Input kits as defined by FNDS for the planting season 2023-2024.\n
